Original face/ears/upper-back/tail remain recognizable, but original rounded torso and chest silhouette are not preserved enough.

contact_control_caveat: Reported world stance spans are rig control coordinates with held-PNG sampling, not a visual painted-sole approval.

endpoint_comparison.interpretation: Decoded RGBA pixels are exactly identical at the two control endpoints. File-byte differences are PNG metadata/encoding only; the reviewed short loop has no endpoint pixel mismatch.
